reason: The hypothesis combines the known benefits of Al and Si additions for oxide film formation with the idea that a refined grain structure synergistically promotes rapid nucleation of a dual-layer oxide at grain boundaries. While the individual elements (Al/Si additions, grain refinement effects) are reported in the passages, the explicit proposal that grain boundary engineering synergizes with Al/Si to form a continuous dual-layer Al2O3-Cr2O3 film that retards dissolution is a synthesis of findings from multiple papers (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P17, P32) and addresses the conflicting observation in P6 that fine grains can accelerate dissolution. This integration goes beyond what any single passage states.
